inlines.v: COMPREHENSIVE, adjective 1. Having the quality of comprising much, or including a great extent; extensive; as a comprehensive charity; a comprehensive view. It seems some times to convey the sense of comprehending much in a small compass. 2. Having the power to comprehend or understand many things at once; as a comprehensive head.
